#### 启动与依赖

| 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 |
|---|---|---|---|
| DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1、Node >=24.9.0 | 包声明的运行条件 | 加载host/client及当前事件接口 | 未核实目标版本兼容前不外推旧版可用 |
| webServer与客户端连接/设置/会话服务 | 网页挂件必需 | HTTP状态、资源和UI挂载 | 没有网页服务不是独立桌面宠物替代 |
| 内置或有效manifest与资源文件 | 渲染必需 | 角色动画和文案 | 无效条目跳过，查diagnostics及实际生效来源 |
| 可写DSH_HOME | 状态跨重启保留所需 | 名称、积分、位置与选择 | 写失败仍可内存运行，不能承诺持久保存 |
| 浏览器解码/Canvas或相应fallback能力 | 按renderer | 图片和帧序列播放 | 设备资源需实测，不把缓存预算当整进程限制 |
| 用户提供的Core/模型材料与适用使用许可 | Live2D路径所需 | 加载Live2D运行时和模型 | 缺Core走指引，先用内置2D避免扩大配置范围 |

服务访问依赖loopback同源或宿主可选配对通道，不是租户权限模型。[Q03](#research-q03) [Q04](#research-q04)

#### 成本

| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 首次 | 插件/内置资产下载和本地存储；金额未知 | 兼容核对、选形象和摆放；耗时未知 | 不需额外账号支撑内置2D，但不能据此称总成本为零 |
| 持续 | 前台轮询、动画解码、CPU/GPU内存与电力；用量未知 | 看状态或被打断、调气泡强度 | 128MiB非整插件硬上限，Live2D另有资源 |
| 失败恢复 | 资源重载/重新解码和状态文件存储 | 查无效manifest、恢复内置形象、核对重启状态 | best-effort写盘可丢非关键积分/布局 |
| 扩展/退出 | 自定义资源与运行时存储，许可成本未知 | 核对素材使用条件、主关闭/移除插件 | 内置2D试用更容易收缩范围，无主任务数据迁移依赖 |

没有注意力/性能对照，不推导节时、心理或单位任务收益。[Q04](#research-q04) [Q05](#research-q05)

#### 效果

| 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 |
|---|---|---|
| 状态联动 | 官方事件和流帧投影到状态机 | 真实宿主时序/丢事件表现和理解准确性 |
| 互动与保存 | 冷却/库存/名称/布局规则有实现 | 写盘失败下跨重启保留，不是可靠计量 |
| 可退出界面 | disabled解除host路由并卸载client/poll | 当前环境关闭后的真实资源回收量 |
| 陪伴和低干扰 | 可配置形象、气泡与交互 | 长期喜好、注意力和任务质量改善 |

只解释机制，不把作者历史性能注释或演示当本轮复现。[Q01](#research-q01) [Q04](#research-q04)

事件投影、状态机、互动ledger和资源表分层使规则可独立检查；客户端跨bundle teardown槽与renderer幂等清理值得借鉴，移植需同样释放poll、订阅、位图和晚到异步结果。文件服务的注册集合/realpath/大小检查有具体边界，不能替代第三方资源审计；best-effort持久化与内存去重适合装饰状态，不能直接复制成业务账本。[Q02](#research-q02) [Q03](#research-q03) [Q04](#research-q04)
插件把宿主活动投影、资源注册与可拆卸网页挂件组合，使状态反馈和形象扩展不必写死在单个角色组件里。它提供陪伴和状态查看入口，不把完成回合奖励解释为任务质量，亦不将宠物/Live2D概念归为原创。[Q01](#research-q01) [Q02](#research-q02)

最影响采用的是反馈是否比原生状态增加价值而不分散注意。全局动作跟最新事件、气泡可优先当前会话，completed和测试情绪都只反映宿主结构状态；若读者把它当验收依据就会误解。积分/位置又是best-effort保存，128MiB只是部分位图预算，不能承诺业务可靠性或零资源成本。[Q02](#research-q02) [Q03](#research-q03) [Q04](#research-q04)
可研究按用户主任务收敛提示强度，保留状态事实和展开入口，优先凸显等待过久/需要用户动作等边界。用同用户交叉比较原生状态、当前宠物和克制策略的漏看、发现时间、无关打断及主任务质量；若漏报增加或用户不愿保留，应否定收益。该策略未实现或验证，不把可爱动画当效率证明。[Q05](#research-q05)

technical.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)host/client接线把既有宠物概念接到DSH，novelty取25%（9），超过零因有具体会话联动，未到50%因动画/桌宠/事件映射为成熟方法，未见新原理。[Q02](#research-q02)官方/legacy奖励分工及ledger:217-237是局部控制增量，mechanism取25%（8），高于零因处理重复事件，未到50%因内存去重且不改变任务正确性。[Q03](#research-q03)ui-teardown:29-46与[Q04](#research-q04)renderer清理可迁移到插件热更新/媒体UI，transferability取50%（10），超过25%因生命周期接口明确，未到75%因跨宿主实测及资源语义仍特定。[Q04](#research-q04)registry来源分层与renderer契约将形象数据和host代码分开，simplification取50%（8），高于25%单换图便利因多来源/多renderer共享入口，未到75%因manifest与大资源/运行时配置仍有负担。

business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)原生状态与静态挂件参照下，事件气泡/可互动入口局部改变等待查看方式，workflow取25%（9），高于零因可直接接到当前会话反馈，未到50%因没有重组主任务分工/交接且干扰收益未知。[Q02](#research-q02)completed奖励不验证业务结果，原交付仍由DSH任务完成，delivery取0是核对后未见新业务交付单元，不以未知质量补零。[Q01](#research-q01)网页用户无需写渲染代码即可换注册形象，reach取25%（5），超过零因降低局部素材接入操作，未到50%因仍需DSH/浏览器及资源条件且没有新增人群证据。[Q04](#research-q04)仍消耗本地动画/轮询与注意力，没有改变主任务计价、资源组织或服务方式，economics取0是对照后未识别结构增量，不是用未知费用或注意力补零。

recommendation.reason: 喜欢可选视觉陪伴、设备资源充足的DSH网页用户可以先用内置2D宠物观察一次普通多阶段会话。相对静态挂件，它把宿主状态接到动画与可关闭气泡，并提供互动，但陪伴和注意力收益尚未实测。若挂件遮挡操作、持续分心或资源明显增长，用户应主关闭并回原生会话状态，不把done或积分当任务验收。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)README:18-43和client挂载说明等待/状态查看的人群、原生状态基线和显示合格结果，取50%（15），超过25%偶然想象因实际阶段和交互链明确，未到75%因痛点强度及持续偏好主要为作者设想，无用户需要承担装饰负担的直接材料。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)官方事件/多会话投影比静态图有可解释状态信息，[Q03](#research-q03)支持关闭与恢复，取50%（13），超过25%单入口便利因输入随真实事件变化，未到75%因原生状态本已可查看，真实理解/等待体验及干扰没有对照。

evidence.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)入口到host路由，[Q02](#research-q02)事件/奖励，[Q03](#research-q03)失败保存和禁用，[Q04](#research-q04)资源/预算链均有固定源码，可支持内置2D可逆试用，取50%（13），超过25%局部材料因关键调用与失败明确，未到75%因没有运行同版本宿主或视觉/性能检查，测试数量不算执行。

cost.rationale: [Q03](#research-q03)主开关拆UI/poll/routes且仅装饰状态，内置2D避免额外Core，[Q04](#research-q04)仍需资源/注意力核对且保存失败静默，取50%（10），超过25%因退出具体且不需主任务数据迁移，未到75%因总体性能未测、frame窗口可超预算及状态保留仍需复查，不能以无账号当零负担。

publication.capabilities.table:
| 能力 | 主要用途 | 使用条件与边界 |
|---|---|---|
| 浮动宠物与气泡 | 在网页显示会话活动 | 不等同独立桌面进程或任务验收 |
| 多会话反馈 | 查看顶层会话状态并优先当前会话 | 全局动画跟最新事件，子Agent不另列导航气泡 |
| 摸头与喂食 | 增加装饰积分并反馈反应 | 冷却/库存限制，积分不是业务绩效 |
| 改名与布局 | 保存per-pet名字、选择和位置 | 尽力持久化，成功响应不保证已写盘 |
| 隐藏/召唤与主开关 | 缩小显示或停用挂件 | 主关闭才同时拆路由/UI/poll，漏事件不补放 |
| 资源注册表 | 加载内置/自定义宠物及覆盖 | 同ID后层覆盖，查diagnostics和来源 |
| sprite2d/frames2d/Live2D路径 | 适配不同资产播放 | Live2D需额外Core，frames预算非总内存保证 |
| 受限资源路由 | 给浏览器加载注册文件 | 集合、realpath、大小及访问门限制，不是全面安全审计 |

{ "path": "README.md", "content": "# dsh-pet · Desktop Pet Companion & Interactive Live2D Widget for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)\n\nEnglish | [中文](README.zh.md)\n\n

\n Interactive Desktop Pet Companion & Live2D Widget for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
\n Agent State Tracking · Live2D & Sprite Pets · Interactive Feeding · Status Bubbles · DSH Workshop\n

\n\n> A registry-driven desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness — featuring the built-in anime whale girl plus one-click installs for any custom Live2D or sprite pet from the Workshop.\n\nWhile the AI model thinks, you wait — your desktop companion swims and interacts on screen. It dynamically tracks the official DeepSeek Harness session lifecycle, switching fluid animations during waiting, thinking, tool execution (Bash, code editing, web searches), reply generation, celebration on success, and alert on error; you can pat its head, feed it dried fish, and watch affinity grow. Pets are driven by an extensible asset registry rather than hard-coded logic: each pet consists of a `pet.json` manifest and an atlas image (or Live2D model pack), auto-discovered by the host at startup.\n\nRe-engineered from desktop companion concepts into an official DSH cordis bundle (host backend + client frontend in a single integrated package).\n\n## Features\n\n| Feature | Description |\n|---|---|\n| Multi-pet registry | The host scans built-in `assets/`, the hatch-pet custom pets directory, and composed config entries; each pet is a manifest plus an atlas |\n| Pet selection in settings | Visual preview cards list every registered pet (built-in assets plus user directories — the installed set); switching persists and the sprite swaps immediately. The page sits under Settings → Web Extensions → Pet, or in the standalone first-level Pet section without that parent |\n| Per-pet naming | Rename from the hover panel; each pet keeps its own name (stored per pet id, migrated from the legacy flat name) |\n| State animation | Official session activity → manifest-defined sequences of 9-state tracks; each track finishes its full duration before the sequence advances and the complete sequence loops |\n| Head-pat interaction | Click the pet → bubble feedback + affinity +1 (10s cooldown) |\n| Feeding | Hover panel 喂食 (Feed) → consumes 1 dried fish + affinity +5 (30s cooldown) |\n| Treat economy | Dried-fish stock (cap 20): +1 every 30 rounds of work, +1 every 300 minutes (5 hours) — 10x rarer than the original cadence |\n| Affinity | +1 per round completed; 9 levels: 幼鲸 → 伙伴 → 挚友 → 深海羁绊 → 心有灵犀 → 传说羁绊 → 神话羁绊 → 永恒之契 → 鲸生共渡 (capped at 999,999,999) |\n| Dragging | Hold and drag the pet to reposition; position persisted |\n| Hide/Summon | The hover panel sits below the pet (lifted above the status bubbles when there is no room below) and provides 隐藏 (Hide); after hiding, a 召唤{name} (Summon {name}) button appears |\n| Witty remarks | Built-in remark library (10 lines per event) plus per-pet custom lines; success lines rotate by persisted success counts and cooldown lines by persisted rejection counts |\n| Status bubbles | Only one top-level session speaks by default — the session the GUI is currently on when it is reported, otherwise the most recently active one — and the rest collapse behind a +N badge on the main bubble instead of stacking a tall column; hover the bubble (or tap the badge, for touch) to fan every session's bubble out above it and click one to jump to its session; subagent sessions report through their spawning conversation and never occupy a bubble of their own; transient interaction feedback temporarily takes priority. Bubble copy comes from generous rotating pools per scene (waiting / thinking / writing / done / failed...), tool calls map onto per-family witty lines carrying the real argument hint (e.g. 跑跑 npm test), and a long-lived scene re-phrases itself every few seconds. The pet's own status bubbles can be silenced in Settings > Pet > Status bubbles, which leaves the row to a plugin driving its own bubble surface; announcements pushed through `pet.announce` keep rendering either way |\n| Inner whispers | 碎碎念: while a session streams, the pet occasionally speaks its inner voice through that session's own bubble — a fresh whisper takes over the bubble and marks it with 「」 quotes — sharing the same DeepSeek-blue glass as every status bubble, so stacked bubbles never clash — instead of stacking a second bubble — category lines woken by the SITUATION (thinking / writing / the running tool family) plus outcome lines woken only by structured results (test green from a passed test tool, error from a failed tool result, completion from a completed turn) — never from the model's words, so a discussion that merely mentions a keyword cannot wake a mood, and a whisper never quotes real content (no tool names, paths or model text); paced by cooldowns (9 s category, 5 s outcome) and an 8 s display TTL, the status copy returns after a few seconds |\n| Multi-session activity | The pet is host-global: the most recent meaningful event drives the sprite animation while every active top-level session reports its own state in a separate bubble; completed turns from every session (subagents included) contribute affinity and treats |\n| Voice packs and panel DIY | A per-pet voice.json plus the global $DSH_HOME/pets/.voice.json override replace every bubble word and the hover panel (button labels, stat formats, button visibility, affinity rank names); merge precedence per-pet > global > built-in, broken packs warn and never reject a pet |\n| Plugin panel actions | A sibling plugin registers its own action into the hover panel's action row through the in-process pet service (`ctx.pet.registerPanelAction({ id, label, onSelect })`); the pet renders the button and dispatches the click back to the plugin's own callback, and the action goes away with the registration |\n\n## Pet contract\n\nA pet is a directory holding one `pet.json` manifest and one atlas image. Nothing else is required — no host or client code changes.\n\n```jsonc\n{\n \"id\": \"whale-girl\", // unique lowercase kebab id\n \"displayName\": \"鲸鱼娘\", // shown in the settings selector and panel\n \"description\": \"A soft healing whale-girl.\", // optional\n \"spritesheetPath\": \"spritesheet.webp\", // atlas, relative to the manifest\n \"cell\": { \"width\": 192, \"height\": 208 }, // optional; defaults to the Codex contract\n \"columns\": 8, // optional; default 8\n \"spriteVersionNumber\": 1, // optional; 2 marks an 11-row v2 atlas (9 animation rows + 2 look rows)\n \"frames\": [6, 8, 8, 4, 5, 8, 6, 6, 6], // optional per-row frame counts\n \"tracks\": { // optional per-track rhythm overrides\n \"idle\": { \"durations\": [400, 400, 500, 400, 400, 500] }\n },\n \"sequences\": { // optional per-scene track sequences (at least 5 items each)\n \"thinking\": [\"running\", \"running-right\", \"running\", \"running-left\", \"waiting\"]\n },\n \"remarks\": { // optional witty remarks (one line or a pool per slot)\n \"pet\": \"摸摸水獭的头～\",\n \"feed\": [\"小鱼干真香\", \"再来一条～\"]\n }\n}\n```\n\n- The atlas is an 8-column × 9-row grid (192×208 cells by default); rows are fixed in this order: 0 idle, 1 running-right, 2 running-left, 3 waving, 4 jumping, 5 failed, 6 waiting, 7 running, 8 review. Unused cells stay fully transparent. v2 Codex atlases declare `\"spriteVersionNumber\": 2` and hold 11 rows — the same 9 animation rows plus 2 trailing look rows; the plugin renders the 9 animation rows and ignores the look rows.\n- The optional remarks block overrides the reaction bubbles the pet speaks on pet / petCooldown / feed / feedCooldown / noTreats events. Each slot accepts one line or a pool of lines; a declared slot replaces the built-in pool for that slot only. Success and cooldown pools use the corresponding persisted success or rejection count, while noTreats cycles independently.
